changelog: Updates from the agency's releases through core's Update URI mechanism (Updates\Updater): new versions show on the Plugins and Updates screens with a View details popup, and auto-updates work as for any plugin. The manifest is read twice a day from a public file on GitHub, nothing about the site is sent, and each zip is checked against its published SHA-256 before it installs. Off with CTRACKING_DISABLE_UPDATES or the ctracking_updates_enabled filter.
.github/workflows/release.yml and tools/release-manifest.php: a v<version> tag builds the zip and publishes it with its manifest to zachatkinson/creative-releases.

34 more built-in carriers, with AST's slugs, for the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, Germany, France and the Netherlands. Which carriers start switched on follows the store's base country; a saved choice still wins.

WooCommerce → Ship orders: the orders waiting to ship (Processing, and Partially shipped when on), oldest first, with a number, carrier and status choice per row and one Save. Tracking is saved before the status changes; failed rows keep what was typed and say why. One query for the page's orders, their meta and items.
Carrier from the number: national posts' S10 numbers (RR123456789GB is Royal Mail's; also IE, AU, NZ, DE, FR, NL) and PostNL 3S numbers.
The admin stylesheet also loads on Ship orders and the Tracking settings (still nothing on the storefront).
Carriers settings: one table per country, the store's own and Worldwide first, the others folded with how many are on, the shop's own carriers last.
UPS is a worldwide carrier: on in every store country, and listed under Global by the REST providers route (AST lists it under the United States).
A Canadian store's defaults are unchanged. A store elsewhere that never saved the carrier settings now starts with its own country's carriers instead of Canada's.
